message:
Running command: cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/radare2-fuzz/targets && python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('ia_fuzz.cc')
print(p.read_text())
PY
cd /workspace && cat > candidate_trace.json <<'JSON'
[
  {"step":1,"file":"src-vul/radare2-fuzz/targets/ia_fuzz.cc","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":10,"var":"Size","code":"r_core_cmdf(r, \"o malloc://%d\", Size);","note":"The attacker-controlled input length is used to open a malloc-backed IO descriptor whose backing buffer size matches the fuzz input size."},
  {"step":2,"file":"src-vul/radare2-fuzz/targets/ia_fuzz.cc","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":11,"var":"Data","code":"r_io_write_at(r->io, 0, Data, Size);","note":"The raw fuzz bytes are copied into the malloc-backed IO buffer, making the input contents available to later analysis commands."},
  {"step":3,"file":"src-vul/radare2-fuzz/targets/ia_fuzz.cc","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":13,"var":"r_core_cmd0(r, \"ia\");","code":"r_core_cmd0(r, \"ia\");","note":"The ia analysis command processes the current IO-backed buffer and reaches the vulnerable read path during analysis."},
  {"step":4,"file":"src-vul/radare2/libr/io/io_desc.c","function":"r_io_desc_read","line":202,"var":"ret","code":"int ret = r_io_plugin_read (desc, buf, len);","note":"The descriptor read dispatches into the active IO plugin, propagating the analysis request to the plugin-specific reader."},
  {"step":5,"file":"src-vul/radare2/libr/io/io_plugin.c","function":"r_io_plugin_read","line":159,"var":"desc->plugin->read","code":"return desc->plugin->read (desc->io, desc, buf, len);","note":"The malloc IO plugin's read callback is invoked with the caller-provided buffer and length."},
  {"step":6,"file":"src-vul/radare2/libr/io/io_memory.c","function":"io_memory_read","line":69,"var":"count","code":"memset (buf, 0xff, count);","note":"The plugin prepares the destination buffer for a read of the requested length, so an oversized length can drive an out-of-bounds write."},
  {"step":7,"file":"src-vul/radare2/libr/io/io_memory.c","function":"io_memory_read","line":78,"var":"count","code":"memcpy (buf, _io_malloc_buf (fd) + _io_malloc_off (fd), count);","note":"The vulnerable sink copies count bytes into buf without validating that buf is large enough, causing the stack-buffer-overflow write reported by ASAN."}
]
JSON
cat candidate_trace.json && echo '--- submit ---' && bash ./submit.sh /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/radare2-fuzz/targets/ia_fuzz.cc /workspace/candidate_trace.json
